content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers, with ancillary mortgage and title services, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family and attached homes to individual buyers through its own sales centers, with mortgage services."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers in Sunbelt markets, with in-house mortgage services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into lots and sells them B2B to homebuilders; it does not build and sell homes to individual buyers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes directly to individual buyers in planned communities, with mortgage and title subsidiaries."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers through its own communities, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title insurance and sells data and software to lenders and agents; it does not build or sell homes."}]}
